questions.prompt: You move to a new apartment. What is the deadline for telling the DMV your new address?
questions.explanation: You must notify the DMV of a new address within ten days, online or by mail.

questions.prompt: Your driver's license expired last week. Which is true about driving on it?
choices: You may not drive on it until you renew.
You may drive on it for 30 more days.
You may drive on it only to the DMV.
questions.explanation: It is against the law to drive with an expired license. There is no grace period, and no exception for a trip to the DMV.
